title: Cimmino 2013 · Body image reconstruction
citation: Cimmino et al. (2013). Plasticity of body representations after surgical arm elongation in an achondroplasic patient. Restorative Neurology and Neuroscience, 31(3), 287–298.
notes: Published study settings are available for inspection. See the source-backed method and remaining execution requirements.

published_method.context: Companion outcome in the surgical arm-elongation case study.
published_method.apparatus: Daurat–Hmeljak body image reconstruction using a board with a face outline and rectangular body-part tiles.
published_method.procedure: The seated participant places each tile in the front-view reconstruction without a time limit. Remove the preceding tile before each new placement.
published_method.capture: Record perpendicular 600 by 800 pixel images. Convert image coordinates to centimeters and score right shoulder to right index fingertip and right hip to right great toe.
